market_pain: No Trouble Found can occur when returned components cannot be confirmed as faulty and diagnostic or part-intelligence data is insufficient.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS ECU-local event context can act as part intelligence when DTC alone is weak.
implication: Use NTF and returned-part evidence as primary framing, not degradation prediction.

market_pain: Warranty collaboration and supplier root cause analysis depend on timely diagnostic and warranty data.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can improve what the supplier brings to RCA discussions.
implication: Position as supplier RCA evidence payload.

source_name: AIAG No Trouble Found data analysis
market_pain: System-level issues may appear as replaced components that test NTF, requiring repair and maintenance data mining.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can preserve subsystem-level context before the part is removed.
implication: Design evidence for system-level investigation, not component blame.

market_pain: Field claims, returned parts, dealer narratives, vehicle diagnostics and NTF investigation are difficult to combine.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context becomes one structured signal in warranty analysis.
implication: Keep payload standardized and easy to merge with claims and narratives.

market_pain: Repair, claim, narrative and returned-part data are fragmented; obvious part replacement can miss root cause and create NTF.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can add missing product-side state to fragmented warranty records.
implication: Use returned-part workflow demo rather than generic health dashboard.

market_pain: Supplier claims, CAPA, 8D, SCAR, CoQ / CoPQ and chargebacks require structured workflows and evidence.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS evidence can feed 8D D4 root cause and SCAR evidence sections.

market_pain: Automotive quality workflows track component defects, root cause, CAPA, OEM claims and supplier performance.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can become component-level evidence inside quality dashboards.
implication: Do not build the whole QMS; provide the evidence payload.

market_pain: Suppliers need warranty handling practices and access to relevant analysis data.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS-local evidence may reduce complete dependence on OEM-side data availability.
implication: Frame as supplier-controlled evidence within ECU constraints.

market_pain: Repair order intelligence links technician notes, labor codes, parts and VIN history to reduce NTF.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context is not a repair-order product but can improve downstream diagnostic narratives.
implication: Optional integration path, not initial product.

market_pain: Suppliers face warranty recovery, chargebacks and insufficiently substantiated cases.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can strengthen evidence in commercial responsibility discussions.
implication: Validate with actual chargeback / recovery pain before productizing.

market_pain: Product defects need traceable investigation, evidence, RCCA / 8D and corrective actions.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can be a traceable input to investigation records.
implication: Export evidence in human-readable and structured forms.

market_pain: Vehicle health platforms want telemetry, diagnostics and remote insight but are OEM-platform dependent.
relevance_to_eps_event_context: EPS event context can be future payload for connected diagnostics.
implication: Keep as optional future channel; do not make it the core premise.
